scope: After E79, inspect first two candidate noteheads over do-mi of domini in the Hec est domus antiphon. Source images and published versions already exposed; selection is retrospective and not independent.
convention: Original image pixels, y increases downward; manually selected approximate notehead centres.

items.limit: Square-head centres and syllabic alignment need verification; surrounding red rule is curved.
Irregular Hufnagel heads and stems make centres and underlay uncertain; visually apparent head location is not independently adjudicated.

uncertainty_scope: Post-selection illustrative sensitivity, not measured error, fitted threshold or confidence interval. Assumptions do not verify the notes or rule.
